cast.say: Thirsty, why haunt the drink stockpile?
Two thousand. Same as the day I died.
I was mining three tiles from the barrels.
The Overseer wanted one more stone.
It always wants one more stone.

panels.caption: His old fort had 800 loose stones.

cast.say: Step two: walk to the barrel.
I'm Thirsty. I died beside 2,000 drinks.
Died of thirst beside 150 rough gems.
I died of thirst up a tree.
A fresh mug of ale for you, Thirsty!

panels.caption: The floor is now very cheerful.

cast.say: I like to be near barrels. Just near.
The Overseer says thirst is a hauling issue.
I was NOT a hauling issue!
It's assigned you to haul drinks.
Away from the miners, it says.
I died rich. You'll die interesting.
To remind everyone that drinking exists.

cast.think: I have never been so hydrated.

cast.say: Hand me a pick. Old habits.
I waited decades to hear that.
We made you a memorial mug!
It has a picture of a barrel on it.
Near the barrel, never in it.
The Overseer built another farm plot.

panels.caption: Old fort: 20 farm plots, no well.

cast.say: The pump mist ring! For happy thoughts!
You spray water in the AIR now?
I died thirsty and you're MISTING.

panels.caption: He stood in it for a season.

cast.say: Tell them one sip and I'll leave forever.
Thirty levels up, past the garbage pit.
So maybe this time I drink!
Hi! I'm Annie. I make armor stands.
You can sleep standing up on it!
The Overseer ordered one armor stand.
For everyone. Nobody had a table.
Is your partner an armor stand?
It holds my helmet. That's love.

panels.caption: The goblins left a sympathy card.

cast.say: My old fort had 16,000 smoothing jobs.
Say it, Annie: I don't need more stands.
I own one suit of armor.
The Overseer wants a stand count.
You cut down trees for... THIS?

panels.caption: The elves left. The stand stayed.

cast.say: The Overseer has a new order!
My old fort had four hospitals.
Left flank: me. Right flank: also me.

panels.caption: Easiest squad to inspect in the realm.
Every season, he writes to the empty places.

cast.think: Dear Captain. We miss you. Signed, Six.

cast.say: When I grow up I'll join the militia!

cast.think: I'm going to cry in my helmet.

cast.say: Can I be squad member two?
Name a replacement from your squad.
I'll stay. Off duty, of course.
Welcome to Safety! Thirty levels down!

panels.caption: The stairs were a known issue.

cast.say: Then how do we get down here?
New tip: don't build a beast.
And the haulers carry it back out.

panels.caption: The pit has never been fuller or emptier.

cast.say: Sock-based safety was all we could afford.
We've never had to repaint it!
That's not the win you think.
Sir, all visitors must sign in.

panels.caption: It signed as "Totally Not A Beast."

cast.say: Our motto: Safety is a place!
Then build it ON the beast.
Ask the miner on the branch.
Rate how safe you feel, one to ten.
Can I answer from the tavern?
New friends! In emergencies, run to Safety!
Thirty levels down. Past the beast.
It doesn't say. That's the beauty.
Is it safe to play in Safety?
And this is the execution tower.
Want to move Safety up here?
Why are there 800 rocks on the floor?
Twenty farm plots. No meat anywhere.
The dwarves called it the Meat Watch.
I've been staring at it for a year.
Why are all the walls smooth?
Where do I hang my spikes?
The ghost keeps telling us to drink.
Hi! I used to live here.
Can I grab my old mug?
So why'd a dwarf die of thirst?
I died here. I vote twice.
We'll be fine. We have dogs.

cast.think: I sleep in plot nineteen now.

cast.say: We don't judge. You don't cut trees.

panels.caption: Best trade relationship in the region.

cast.think: Math is a liaison skill, apparently.

cast.say: There is much to share... about weather.
We're at peace with sixteen groups!
There is a little more to share.
Take notes. There is much to share...
There is much to share. With nobody.
The Amusing Duties changed hands again.
I must depart. There is much to share.

panels.caption: He said this last year too.

cast.say: There will be MUCH to share.
Barkeep! There is much to share!
It's the only thing I'm trained to say.
A butcher in a mood! What do you need?
I am taken by a strange mood!
The moods have a system now.
They check which stockpile hit zero...
So never let anything hit zero?
I'm keeping one rough gem. Just in case.

panels.caption: Gems saved: one. Gems needed: other.
He waited. The construction did not.

cast.say: We have cloth! Seven silk scraps!
So no mood can ask for one!

panels.caption: He went home and stared at a wall.

cast.say: It's a meat famine. We have none.
Then I'll wait for a tree to grow.
I've hidden a bit of everything.
80% chance of wanting the last thing.
The thing before the last thing.
I was cutting the last rough gem.
Help! I'm stuck on a branch!
What about falling out of them?
That's what it WANTS you to think.
Then how do we get the fruit?
We wait for it to fall.

panels.caption: The mug made it. The drink did not.

cast.say: Died of thirst up a tree? Amateur.
The cat's stuck up the tree!
Cats are the only ones who come down.
The Overseer wants a tree farm.

panels.caption: Tree farm planted. Dwarves avoid it.

cast.say: Windmills! Now we need fewer trees!
A tree is the closest thing.
He's been yelling at a tree for an hour.

gags.caption: Local ghost asks that the barrels be moved closer to the mines. Or the mines closer to the barrels.
"I'll drink after this tile," he said, about four hundred tiles ago.
The ghost now gives guided tours of the drink stockpile. He never touches anything. He can't.
A full mug is left out nightly for the thirsty ghost. By morning it is still full.
"Drink break: when the Overseer says." The Overseer has not said.
Died of thirst beside a heap of rough gems. Rough gems: still rough. Ghost: still thirsty.
{drinks} drinks in stock, and somehow a queue of parched miners. Statisticians are baffled.
Down to {drinks} drinks. The thirsty ghost has started a support line. It is mostly sighing.
Visiting ghost from {past_fort} says he remembers {record}. He mostly remembers being thirsty.
Ghost haunts one specific branch. Says the view is nice. The bar was not.
The tavern's ghost asks patrons to drink slower, so he can enjoy it vicariously.
Ghost says he is "proud" of everyone using the well. Then he cried into it.
A bucket brigade to the miners has been proposed. The Overseer counter-proposed more mining.
The gods blinked and the world rewound. The ghost checked. Still thirsty.
The armor stand collection now reaches the horizon. Suits of armor: one, on loan.
Guest room now features an armor stand. And another. The bed is also, on inspection, an armor stand.
{record_fort} remembers {record}. Nobody remembers asking for them.
So many thrones, so few tables. The noble eats standing up, beside a throne, like a commoner.
Work order: "armor stand, repeat." The workshop asked when to stop. It was not told.
Goblin raiders made off with forty armor stands. They are said to be deeply confused about why.
Carpenter dreams of armor stands. Wakes up. Makes armor stands. Calls it a career.
"Buy one armor stand, get one hundred free." The elves have asked to leave.
Quakefocus built 1,981 armor stands and 148 thrones: a well-dressed fort with nowhere to sit.
Mayor charges a carpenter with "production order violation" for making only 1,000 of something.
Three smoothers, sixteen thousand smoothing jobs. They have agreed to meet again in a decade.
The Overseer smoothed the walls, the floors, and a dwarf who stood still too long.
Captured goblin complains the walls are "too smooth to scratch threats into."
Plant gathering continues across the whole map, in the rain. One wet berry has come home.
The Overseer's strategy was explained to the fort. The fort asked for it again, slower.
A work order for one crown produced eighty crowns. Crown surplus: huge. Kings: none.
The fort has four hospitals and two doctors. The other two hospitals are run on hope.
Militia roster: one captain, nine empty places. The empty places have never missed a drill.
The militia's schedule reads "Off duty" in every month. The captain has framed it.
Official militia group portrait. The painter calls it the easiest group of his career.
The captain books a table for his whole squad every night. It is a big table for one dwarf.
At war with {enemy}. Our militia, all one of it, is ready. Ish.
{enemy} scouts report the fort's army is "one dwarf and a vibe."
The captain has promoted the dog to lieutenant. The dog is already more on duty than anyone.
{civ} asks why the militia is still one dwarf. {past_fort} asked too, before it {past_fort_fate}.
Militia recruitment booth relocated to the tavern. Signups unchanged. Tab enormous.
The captain writes letters to his nine empty squad positions. Squad member six is his favorite.
A forgotten beast reviewed our defenses. One star. "Barely noticed him."
{monarch} demands a stronger militia. The captain offered to stand up straighter.
The Safety burrow has been renamed "Safety (Not Guaranteed)."
Safety burrow designers forgot that stairs go both ways.
Safety is thirty levels down, so evacuees arrive exhausted. Planners call it "a feature."
Garbage pit update: one dwarf throws refuse in, another hauls it out. They wave at each other.
New sign at the garbage pit: "PLEASE STOP RESCUING THE GARBAGE."
Turnout at today's Safety drill was low, except for the beast, who never misses one.
The new Safety officer's first act: one sock per dwarf. Feet: safer. Everything else: same.
Most residents now consider the tavern the real Safety burrow. It has better lighting and ale.
A ghost from {past_fort} has volunteered as Safety inspector. He has seen how things end.
"Days since last incident" sign has been replaced with a single, honest zero carved in stone.
The execution tower now has a better safety record than the Safety burrow.
The fifteen ghosts of the Creaturemirrored Safety burrow now sing in a choir. Mostly about stairs.
Goblins at {past_fort} call it "lovely, but full of rocks and a ghost who wants a drink."
Goblin landlords of {past_fort} have raised the rent. Nobody pays rent. They raised it anyway.
Goblins who seized our old fort have been seized in turn by its dogs.
Goblin travel guide rates {past_fort}: "Great walls. Smooth. Too smooth. Also haunted."
{past_fort} lasted {past_fort_years}. Its ghosts have lasted longer, and complain about it.
Conquering goblins spent their first year hauling the dwarves' loose stones. Victory is tiring.
Goblins at our old fort have planted the farm plots with "menace." It is not coming up.
The Torments of Hating still hold Searabbeys. Nobody there knows what The Nuanced Hamlet is for.
Searabbeys' goblin occupiers have nearly drunk the 1,994 drinks. The ghost has filed a complaint.
Goblins at our old fort have cancelled their subscription to this paper. They never had one.
The goblins evicted the dwarves, but no one has been able to evict the dwarven ghost.
The liaison announced "there is much to share" and shared it with nobody for a season.
{liaison} recommends an import agreement. Of what, {liaison} did not say.
The liaison requested rings at 210 percent. Our jewelers requested a definition of percent.
{liaison} of {civ} says there is much to share. The share was mostly about {past_fort}.
{monarch} sends warm regards, a request for thrones, and no thrones.
The liaison says we remain at war with {enemy}. He recommends an import agreement.
Minutes of the liaison meeting, in full: "There is much to share."
The liaison asked for a tour. He saw the tavern, the tavern and, by request, the tavern.
Iden Loloklolor has once again shared that there is much to share. He has not shared what.
The Chambers of Steel: at peace with sixteen groups, at war with two. The two are at the gate.
Gift from the mountainhomes: one sock. There was much to share. This was not it.
The liaison says all of {world} is talking about our fort. He would not say what.
A strange mood demands rough gems one day after the jewelers proudly cut the last one.
A dwarven toddler in a strange mood demands plant cloth. Nobody has ever had plant cloth.
A fisherdwarf in a mood demands a rough gem. A fish was offered. The fish was rejected.
Butcher in a fey mood requests rough gems. Asked why, he said "moods don't explain."
Possessed weaver still waiting on the loom room. Loom room still waiting on the Overseer.
Inventory lists "cloth." It is seven silk scraps and a sock. The moody weaver is not amused.
Mood forecast: whatever we ran out of this morning, someone will need by lunch.
{stone} stones in stock, and the moody mason wants the one stone we don't have.
The latest mood has claimed a workshop and asked for the last thing we sold to the caravan.
We traded away our rough gems this morning. The mood started this afternoon. Of course it did.
At Creaturemirrored, a fisherdwarf, a butcher and a weaver each wanted rough gems. All cut.
One dwarf hides one of everything under her bed "for the next mood." Including the last gem.
"Please check stockpile before having a mood." Sign ignored by the next three moods.
A miner has been stuck on a tree branch for three days. Nice view, he says. Very thirsty.
Tree safety notice: do not climb trees, stand near trees, or make eye contact with trees.
Elves say trees are gentle. Dwarves note that no elf has ever been stuck on one for three days.
A new sapling has appeared near the gate. Dwarves are watching it. It is watching back.
The only resident who can get down from a tree is the cat. It has made sure everyone knows.
Woodcutter reports the trees "know." Asked what they know, he chopped faster.
Plant-gathering in the rain, among the trees: "the worst of everything at once."
It is autumn. The trees are dropping leaves on dwarves. Dwarves are taking it personally.
Wood is low and the Overseer wants more trees. The dwarves wish to note they warned everyone.
The ghost of the miner who died up a tree has been asked to haunt somewhere lower.
Creaturemirrored's tree-branch ghost was invited to Thirsty Ghosts Anonymous. He can't get down.
The gods blinked and the world restarted. Nobody is to mention the Great Rewind again.
A dwarf fell asleep, the gods blinked, and he woke up yesterday. He is calling it a nap.
A moment of silence for {past_fort}, which lasted {past_fort_years}. A work order interrupted it.
Record from {record_fort}: {record}. Residents must not try to beat it. The Overseer was not told.
Newcomer asks what lies beyond {world}. Nobody knows. The Overseer says "more work orders."
{enemy} has sent demands. Item one: "your drinks." Items two to nine: "also your drinks."
Guide to {enemy_race}s: they are mean, they are loud, and they are coming. Bring a mug.
The Crazed Hex has emptied Padtufted, Pulledrained and Ironcrowds. Our militia: one dwarf, off duty.
The Amusing Duties, steel greaves, has had about 48 owners. Experts say greaves want to be free.
The Chaste Cudgel reclaimed Tametomb; The Oily Boots work on Scaldedarch. We reclaimed the tavern.
The crooked horror Omo Fewethauyira declined to comment, being a crooked horror.
Glimmerpartnered's elves are "worried" about our tree policy. We could not reply. We were up a tree.
Monarch Oddom Oltartilesh has heard about the 148 thrones. He asked if any were nearby.
Quakefocus remembered: 1,981 armor stands, 148 thrones, 16,000 smoothing jobs, three smoothers.
Searabbeys remembered: twenty farm plots, thirteen dogs, two thousand drinks, no meat.
The Overseer's latest memo says "more." Dwarves asked "more what." It was reissued: "more."
The Overseer has a vision for the fort. Nobody knows it. Everyone suspects armor stands.
The Overseer has made a burrow called "Safety 2." Nobody asks what happened to Safety 1.
Reminder: the garbage pit is for throwing things in. Not taking things out. Not falling in.
{pop} residents, one militia captain. The captain has asked to be cloned. Request denied.
With only {pop} residents, the militia of one now makes up a worrying share of the population.
Vacant: mayor, sheriff, hammerer, champion, chief medical dwarf. Applicants: none.
The mayor has filed this week's "production order violation." It was against a barrel.
The hammerer post is still open. Bring your own hammer and no conscience.
Chief medical dwarf: vacant. Patients diagnose themselves. Most say "thirst."
The pump mist ring sprays everyone for happy thoughts. The thirsty ghost calls it insensitive.
New windmills spin happily. The dwarves trust them more than trees, which is a low bar.
The catacombs are full. The ghosts have started a lending library of complaints.
The new cistern holds water for every dwarf. Getting miners to visit it is a separate project.
The roving camera followed an elf for a whole season. The elf has asked for privacy.
Caravan traders say they visited {past_fort} once. "Lovely place," they say. "Before."
